title: Wildpark Wildbichl Niederndorferberg
highlights: Nature-oriented wildlife sanctuary covering more than 80,000 m² in the Kaiserwinkl
Native alpine animal species including red deer, fallow deer, ibex, and elusive lynx
Delightful petting zoo with friendly goats, sheep, and miniature rabbits for children
Educational botanical tree trail describing over 60 indigenous trees and shrubs
kurzbeschreibung: Wildpark Wildbichl on the Niederndorferberg is home to native wildlife in spacious natural enclosures against the backdrop of the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung:
Wildlife Encounters in Natural Surroundings

The Wildpark Wildbichl is picturesquely situated at around 800 metres above sea level on the Niederndorferberg in the Tyrolean Unterland, close to the Bavarian border. Across an expansive woodland and meadow area covering more than eight hectares, mainly native animal species thrive in species-appropriate enclosures.

An Experience for Families and Nature Enthusiasts

Visitors can observe red deer, chamois, mouflons, wild boars, and elusive lynx up close, with opportunities to feed some of them using specially provided food. An informative tree trail highlights more than 60 native trees and shrubs, while the children's adventure playground and the Gasthof Wildbichl inn round off a memorable day out.
